metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure backend-layers from .claude/orrery/plan.json, with .claude/orrery/decisions.md applied # (the CLI node, its group and the Excel/CSV loaders are not drawn: cli/main.py:86 builds # SyncEngine(session) with no user_id, so that path raises today). # Every edge is a call site read from the code (source: inferred); evidence paths are relative # to the repo root and checked with `orrery verify`. # Routers api/main.py:355-372 registers beyond the ones drawn (dashboard_metrics, weekly_recap, rsu_tax, # bank_alerts, balance_checks, card_cycles, cas_upload, category_suggestions, push, review_queue, # safe_to_spend, semantic_search, tax_ais, tax_deductions, mcp) are left out on purpose: each has the same # router -> service or core -> ORM shape as a router drawn here, and a seventh router widens the api row # until the figure no longer reads at 880 px. The Dashboard metrics path is drawn in finance-composition # and analytics-boundaries. title: "Backend layers: api, services, core, ingest, db" subtitle: FastAPI calls from the routers down to Neon; every financial router also takes the API deps direction: down layout: { spacing: compact }
groups: l-api: type: zone label: api/ (routers) evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:336-372 l-services: type: zone label: services/ evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:1 l-core: type: zone label: core/ evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:1 l-ingest: type: zone label: ingest/ evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/normalizer.py l-db: type: zone label: db/ evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:70 # Cross-cutting identity and session deps every financial router takes (loop.md reduce rung 1), # nested in api/ because deps.py lives there; the deps -> c-tokens and deps -> orm edges are # implied: verify_token at deps.py:51, get_session at deps.py:18. l-shared: type: zone label: Shared services in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:30-197
nodes: r-upload: icon: tabler:upload label: Upload router in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:39-80 r-analytics: icon: tabler:chart-line label: Analytics v2 router in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:30 r-calc: icon: tabler:calculator label: Calculations router in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations.py:27 r-aichat: icon: tabler:message-chatbot label: AI chat router in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:60-77 r-aitools: icon: tabler:tool label: AI tools router note: 15 read-only tools in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_tools.py:25-31 r-oauth: icon: tabler:login label: OAuth router in: l-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:57 # Stands for every router -> deps edge (plan leftOut): financial routers take CurrentUser and DatabaseSession. # Drawn without edges as a shared service; the api/ -> ORM group edge covers its session reads. deps: icon: tabler:plug-connected label: API deps note: CurrentUser, DatabaseSession, verify JWT in: l-shared evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:30-197
s-upload: icon: tabler:package-import label: Upload service in: l-services evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:14 # Lives in services/ledger_dimensions.py:189 and is called from core's sync engine. s-dims: icon: tabler:dimensions label: Ledger dimensions in: l-services evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:173#attach_ledger_dimensions - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/ledger_dimensions.py:189#attach_ledger_dimensions s-calc: icon: tabler:math-function label: Calculation service in: l-services evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/calculation_service.py:62-105 s-auth: icon: tabler:user-shield label: Auth service in: l-services evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_service.py:107
c-sync: icon: tabler:arrows-exchange label: Sync engine in: l-core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:78 c-recon: icon: tabler:git-compare label: Reconciler in: l-core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/reconciler.py c-analytics: icon: tabler:chart-dots label: Analytics engine note: versioned refresh in: l-core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/engine.py:104 c-rules: icon: tabler:list-check label: Metric rules in: l-core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py:139 c-tokens: icon: tabler:id-badge label: JWT tokens in: l-core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/auth/tokens.py
i-norm: icon: tabler:filter-check label: Normalizer in: l-ingest # ingest/validator.py is only used by the CLI loaders, so it is not part of this node. evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/normalizer_rows.py:262#normalize_from_dict - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/normalizer_rows.py:58#validate_normalized_row i-hash: icon: tabler:hash label: Transaction hasher in: l-ingest evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/reconciler.py:53#TransactionHasher
orm: icon: tabler:table label: ORM models, session in: l-db evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/db/models.py - backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:70 # Pooler: repo CLAUDE.md Deployment section (decisions.md item 2). SQLite in development (session.py:14-39). pg: icon: logos:neon-icon label: Neon PostgreSQL note: PgBouncer pooler evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:14-39 - CLAUDE.md#PgBouncer
edges: # Upload path - r-upload -> s-upload: { label: process_upload, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:80#process_upload" } - s-upload -> c-sync: { label: import_rows, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:24#import_rows" } - s-upload -> c-analytics: { label: refresh, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:33#refresh_analytics" } - r-analytics -> c-analytics: { label: retry refresh, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:26", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:46"] } - c-sync -> i-norm: { label: "normalize, validate", evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:301#normalize_from_dict", "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:232"] } - c-sync -> s-dims: { label: attach dimensions, constraint: false, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:173#attach_ledger_dimensions } - c-sync -> c-recon: { label: reconcile batches, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:175#reconcile_batch", "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:183"] } - c-recon -> i-hash: { label: SHA-256 IDs, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/reconciler.py:53#TransactionHasher" } - c-sync -> orm: { label: commit reconciled rows + import log, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:202-207" } # Analytics - c-analytics -> c-rules: { label: classify, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/summaries.py:17#is_essential_expense" } - c-analytics -> orm: { label: publish rollups, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/engine.py:287#publish_refresh" } # Auth - r-oauth -> s-auth: { label: login or register, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:263-270#oauth_login_or_register" } - s-auth -> c-tokens: { label: issue tokens, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:19#create_tokens", "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:84"] } - s-auth -> orm: { label: users + refresh records, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_service.py:185", "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:81"] } # Ledger dimensions upserts account and category rows on conflict-do-nothing. - s-dims -> orm: { label: upsert dimensions, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/ledger_dimensions.py:57" } # Calculations - r-calc -> s-calc: { label: bounded reads, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations.py:19" } - s-calc -> orm: { label: aggregate SQL, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/calculation_service.py:14-20" } # Every member of api/ touches ORM models directly, so one group edge stands for them all: # analytics v2 reads rollups (analytics_v2_impl/summaries.py:18), calculations runs SQL # aggregates (calculations_impl/aggregates.py:22), OAuth consumes its audit_logs state row # (oauth_state.py:111-130), AI chat writes usage reservations (ai_chat.py:120), AI tools read # user-scoped rows (ai_tools.py:88), upload lists import_logs (upload.py:132) and the deps # open the session and load the User (deps.py:18, deps.py:133). - l-api -> orm: label: routers read and write models evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2_impl/summaries.py:18 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations_impl/aggregates.py:22 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth_state.py:111-130 - "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:120#reserve_usage" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_tools.py:88#execute" - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:132 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:197 # Shared dependencies # Driver - orm -> pg: { label: psycopg 3, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:14-39" }

svg.title: Backend layers: api, services, core, ingest, db
svg.desc: Backend layers: api, services, core, ingest, db. 20 components in 6 groups. Connections: Upload router to Upload service (process_upload); Upload service to Sync engine (import_rows); Upload service to Analytics engine (refresh); Analytics v2 router to Analytics engine (retry refresh); Sync engine to Normalizer (normalize, validate); Sync engine to Ledger dimensions (attach dimensions); Sync engine to Reconciler (reconcile batches); Reconciler to Transaction hasher (SHA-256 IDs); Sync engine to ORM models, session (commit reconciled rows + import log); Analytics engine to Metric rules (classify); Analytics engine to ORM models, session (publish rollups); OAuth router to Auth service (login or register); Auth service to JWT tokens (issue tokens); Auth service to ORM models, session (users + refresh records); Ledger dimensions to ORM models, session (upsert dimensions); Calculations router to Calculation service (bounded reads); Calculation service to ORM models, session (aggregate SQL); api/ (routers) to ORM models, session (routers read and write models); ORM models, session to Neon PostgreSQL (psycopg 3).

text.tspan: BACKEND LAYERS: API, SERVICES, CORE, INGEST, DB
FastAPI calls from the routers down to Neon; every financial router also takes the API deps
